summary: The biggest gap is systematic section header format drift: 5/7 sub-agents wrote '### 功能概述' (three hashes) instead of the required '#### 功能概述 (Purpose)' (four hashes), causing automated quality checks to report 0% section compliance for those modules despite the content being substantively correct. The first two tasks (scrapydocs, conf) produced correct format; all subsequent agents drifted. Fix priority: (1) Add a prominent format enforcement block and post-write grep check to the DETAIL agent prompt in phase3-detail.md — this single change would fix R5, R5b-adjacent, P3, R7, S2, S6 and raise pass count from 23 to ~27/31; (2) enforce completion of the infrastructure module before Phase 4 to fix coverage below 80%; (3) add automated heading validation in Phase 4 to enforce functional module renaming.
